```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  detect-and-apply-abuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run abuse detection and apply blocks
        run: npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts --last 24h --parallel 3 --auto-apply
```
